ITEM 1 | White square plate, about 26 cm across, used as the scale reference; the food occupies roughly the central 40% of its surface | 0
ITEM 2 | Cubed bread-like pieces, golden-brown on top with pale cream interior, irregular cubes about 1.5–2.5 cm, some with darker toasted edges, scattered through the center-right of the plate | 60
ITEM 3 | Pale off-white flat slices, thin and slightly translucent with a matte surface, about 3–4 cm long and 0.3 cm thick, lying among the greens near the center and lower center | 35
ITEM 4 | Pale green shredded leafy pieces with curled edges and creamy coating, slightly glossy and moist, clustered in the center-left area, about 4–5 cm across | 30
ITEM 5 | Creamy pale sauce or dressing coating the greens and bread, glossy and thick, filling gaps between pieces in the center | 20
ITEM 6 | Pieces of cooked light-brown meat or chicken-like chunks, slightly browned at the edges with a lightly glazed sheen, about 2–3 cm pieces, located center-right | 45
ITEM 7 | Small bright green stalk pieces, thin and slightly glossy, about 3–4 cm long, scattered in the center among the creamy sauce | 8
ITEM 8 | Whole halved Brussels sprout, dark green outer leaves with browned, slightly charred edges and pale inner core, about 3–4 cm across, sitting at lower left of the food | 25
ITEM 9 | Brussels sprout half on the right edge of the plate, golden-green with browned, crisp-looking outer leaves, about 3 cm across, lying alone on the plate | 18
ITEM 10 | Dark green charred Brussels sprout piece with blackened, crinkled leaves and some oil sheen, about 3–4 cm, sitting at right of the food pile | 20
